headline: Sensex drops over 400 points and Nifty falls below 22,700 as oil prices top $110

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices topped $110, putting pressure on Indian equity markets.
Media, FMCG, and IT sector stocks faced heavy selling pressure.
Benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex experienced losses for the third consecutive day.
Investor sentiment was dampened amid broader market sell-offs.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 400 points while Nifty tested levels below 22,700.
Swiggy reported a 36% rise in Q2 revenue, though its narrowed net loss missed estimates.
Jammu & Kashmir Bank Q2 net profit grew over 10% YoY to Rs 546 crore.
Nippon Life announced an interim dividend of Rs 9.50 per share.
summary: Indian benchmark indices fell for the third straight day, with Sensex dropping over 400 points and Nifty settling below 22,700. Declines were driven by rising crude oil prices topping $110 and weakness across Media, FMCG, and IT stocks. Meanwhile, earnings results and dividend announcements drove stock-specific movements.
